zh-Hans: 在长对话中连续接收消息和工具结果，然后向上翻阅并返回最新消息。打开游戏、手记或其他编辑器的助手，切换审批方式，关闭再打开查看所选设置。也可以让普通任务创建游戏，直接从聊天记录试玩。
en-US: Receive a burst of messages and tool results in a long chat, scroll up to read, then return to the latest message. Change approval settings in a game, Notes or another editor assistant and check the choice after reopening. Try playing a game directly from the ordinary task that created it.
